extension.summary: Stops Up and Down jumping ten minutes through a recording
extension.description:
Kodi maps Up and Down during video playback to a ten minute skip, which on a TV remote are the two easiest buttons to press by accident. This add-on gives them something a remote can use instead: Up opens the player OSD, Down closes it, and neither one seeks.
Live TV is left alone, where Up and Down remain channel up and channel down.
The add-on installs a keymap file into your profile and reloads it, so it takes effect without restarting Kodi. Turning its setting off removes the file again.
